data.name: Marvin
data.gender_notes: Marvin is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Marvin is derived from the Old English 'Mægwein' meaning 'little servant' or 'magician'. The name gained popularity in the English-speaking world during the Middle Ages, and was later popularized by the character Marvin Monroe in the 1960s American television series 'Maverick'. The name Marvin carries the meaning “Friend or little servant” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Marvin usually hope their child will grow to embody friend or little servant and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Marvin total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
